newsAll.head: Quinshon Judkins: Clear of injury report
newsAll.body: Judkins (personal) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against Carolina, Scott Petrak of BrownsZone.com reports.

newsAll.head: DeVonta Smith: Getting in some work Friday
newsAll.body: Smith (hamstring) wasn't in uniform at the start of Friday's practice but eventually took part in individual drills before running on a side field, Brooks Kubena of The Athletic reports.

newsAll.head: Saquon Barkley: Practicing again Friday
newsAll.body: Barkley (stinger) is taking part in the open portion of Friday's practice, Brooks Kubena of The Athletic reports.

newsAll.head: Brock Bowers: Listed as questionable for Sunday
newsAll.body: Bowers (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, with head coach Klint Kubiak telling reporters that the tight end's absence from Friday's practice was planned, Sam Warren of The Athletic rep

newsAll.head: Aaron Jones: Will play Sunday
newsAll.body: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Friday that Jones (knee) will be available for Sunday's game at Tampa Bay, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.
